patch_description: This version keeps XGBoost but changes the feature design to be much more regime-invariant and shorter-horizon. Instead of relying on broad absolute levels, it emphasizes rolling z-scores, compact momentum/volatility character changes, and a small set of multiplicative interactions that are more likely to survive regime shifts. The model itself is also made a bit more expressive by reducing over-regularization and using moderately deeper trees with stronger sample requirements, which should help recover prediction variance without reintroducing excessive overfit.
